reasoning_content: The nginx config shows the root is /opt/areloria/client/dist - let me check what's there, and also fix the APK location to match the actual web root.

action.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
c = paramiko.SSHClient()
c.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
c.connect('46.202.154.25', 22, 'root', '2N00py123+++')

# Check actual web root
stdin, stdout, stderr = c.exec_command("ls -la /opt/areloria/client/dist/")
print("Dist:", stdout.read().decode())

# Copy APK to correct location
c.exec_command("cp /opt/areloria/client/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk /opt/areloria/client/dist/arelorian.apk")

print("\n✅ APK copied to: https://arelorian.de/arelorian.apk")

c.close()
EOF
